propositions: The integration test fixture `_load_module` unconditionally replaces `sys.modules["rebar_reconciler.adapters.jira.adf"]` with a new module object, breaking the test-infrastructure invariant that canonical dotted keys must preserve module identity
AdfCodec retains a reference to the prior module object A while the integration fixture installs a distinct object B, causing divergent behavior when both are called
The test only fails in serial full-suite ordering after the round-trip integration fixture runs; isolated runs are green due to module identity mismatch between codec and test monkeypatches

The fix caches modules by both canonical name and `__file__` source path, returning the cached module only when both match the requested source while preserving intentional different-source replacement
Runtime identity instrumentation proved the mechanism by observing A and B as distinct post-fixture and showing codec output follows A exclusively regardless of monkeypatches on B
